scope: Local HTTP protocol fixture; no OpenCode process, model, account or API key.

cases.expected: HTTP create returns session ID; 204 means accepted; later snapshot carries completed assistant evidence.
Abort returns requested and a subsequent snapshot confirms idle.
Unsupported permissions and memory capabilities reject before any HTTP request.
Configuration, authentication, traversal and query-bearing endpoints never reach HTTP.
External, DNS localhost, credential-bearing and non-origin URLs are rejected.
Incorrect health field types are rejected.
Responses larger than 65536 bytes are rejected.
A 30ms timeout causes one HTTP request and no automatic retry.
A 302 redirect is not followed and credentials stay on the original request.
Message info.sessionID must match the selected session.
An unrecognized runtime status cannot become idle or completed.
